source_context: The user asked GPT-6 to independently choose and formalize another worthwhile LeanFrontier mathematical result and validate it before opening an upstream PR. GPT-6 checked the current upstream and synchronized fork, considered the roadmap's warning against shallow mature-cluster corollaries, and chose the general discrete Abel–Liouville theorem for pairs of solutions of variable-coefficient second-order recurrences. It adds the classical Casoratian and product evolution law over arbitrary commutative rings, then specializes to the previously accepted Horadam W recurrence. Mathlib and LeanFrontier searches found no discrete Casoratian interface under the searched names. It does not rely on pending PRs 532 or 533. GPT-6 independently wrote the formal statements and Lean proofs; the human authored no mathematical Lean code.
